solutionSearchEvidence: Current Cloudflare deployment reaches package deployment successfully and fails only at the public Saasuna provider probe with HTTP 502.
Current ws.js maps every non-OK Convai response to the same provider_unavailable state, hiding whether the upstream was unauthorized, forbidden, rate-limited, or unavailable.
